China AI firm DeepSeek develops custom chip; South Korea eyes AI boom funds

Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is reportedly developing its own artificial intelligence chip to reduce reliance on foreign technology. Meanwhile, South Korea is considering using a tax windfall from its booming AI chip industry to fund public projects. This comes as global demand for AI-driven semiconductors continues to fuel economic activity and raise questions about wealth distribution.
